summary: The web's reference layer — now both training data for AI and the target it summarizes away.
moat: Wikipedia's moat is a two-decade corpus of human-verified, citation-backed articles maintained by a volunteer community and strict sourcing policies. That same openness is its exposure: large language models train on Wikipedia and increasingly answer factual questions directly, which can divert the reader traffic and new-editor pipeline the encyclopedia depends on to stay current.

challengers.name: ChatGPT / conversational answer engines
challengers.evidence: OpenAI reported ChatGPT reached ~800M weekly active users in 2025, intercepting factual lookups before they reach Wikipedia.

challengers.name: Google AI Overviews
challengers.evidence: Google rolled AI Overviews out to 200+ countries in 2025, surfacing synthesized answers above traditional reference links.
